subject: pe
title: Healthy Eating: Fuel for Sport
welcome_lead: Eat smart before and after sport — body and mind benefit.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: eating before/after sport, energy timing.
final_note: What you eat after training matters as much as the training.

concepts.def: Eaten after sport to refuel and repair.
Energy released quickly — banana, sports drink.

walkthroughs.body_html: 2-3 hours before, eat a meal with slow carbs and a little protein — pasta with chicken, or oats with banana.
If activity is over an hour, top up with a fast carb like a banana or sports drink.
Within an hour, eat a recovery meal mixing carbs and protein — refills glycogen and helps muscles repair.
